rank_order_summary: 13 of 15 companies (87%) sit in an SPS position consistent with a coarse 5-bin read of their tier; the only two boundary crossings with any real magnitude (Jawbone/Meetup, Ginkgo/Airbnb) are both traceable to specific, identifiable evidence-availability and evidence-reuse causes (see company_disagreement section of PASS_B_REPORT.md), not to random or systematic tier misordering.
